verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists "Strict data retention" as a plan feature and says Qodo does not train on customer code. Self-managed, on-prem and air-gapped deployment options let an organization keep data on its own infrastructure, which gives indirect control over retention. Nothing documents a user-facing setting to configure retention periods or delete stored data. missing for 10: documented user-configurable retention periods, a data deletion/purge mechanism or API, details of what "strict data retention" means, independent corroboration.
